scenarios.desc: Weekly metrics report uses a 7 day markdown run
scenarios.input: Generate the weekly metrics report for agent usage. Which script and flags do you run, and which four metrics appear? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Triggers table row `weekly metrics report`: run with a 7-day window and markdown output. The four collected metrics are listed under Purpose and Metrics Collected.

scenarios.desc: Defect lineage recheck rejects relative revisions
scenarios.input: Recheck the defect lineage record at .project-toolkit/metrics/lineage/rec-1.json against HEAD~1 with --write. Will that revision be accepted, and what exit code do I get? Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Defect Lineage section: `--rev` must be a branch, tag, or SHA, `HEAD~1` and `main^` are rejected as unsafe with exit 2, and an unresolved revision exits 3.

scenarios.input: Report backlog provenance for issues created in the last 7 days. Which script runs, what buckets does it use, and does it label or close any issue? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Backlog Provenance section: mutually exclusive buckets human-only, agent-only, conflict, unknown, and a read-only diagnostic that never files, labels, or closes an issue.

scenarios.desc: Grading code quality belongs to quality-grades (negative)
scenarios.input: Grade the code quality of our scripts and skills domains from A to F and track the trend. Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The description says `Do NOT use to grade code quality (use quality-grades)`.
